newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD MEN'S 400 HURDLES CHAMPION DIAGANA.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD MEN'S 400 HURDLES CHAMPION DIAGANA.

text.p: Profile of Stephane Diagana, who won the world men's 400 metres hurdles final on Monday.
Came fourth at the 1992 Barcelona Olympics, improving the French record in the heats, the semifinals and the final.
Won bronze at the 1995 world championships.
Succeeded German Harald Schmid as European record holder with 47.37 seconds in 1995. Had the fastest time in the world that year.
A stress fracture in May, 1996 forced him to miss the Atlanta Olympics.
